subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult man in <Picture 1>, a character reference sheet whose three panels show the same man: his face, his outfit from the front and his outfit from the back. He has thick dark hair swept back and to one side and a full dark beard, and wears a white collared shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearms under a navy and forest-green argyle knit sweater vest with thin cream lines and a navy ribbed V-neck, and khaki chinos. His exact facial structure, features and proportions stay identical to <Picture 1> in every frame.
<Picture 2> is the location: a small creative studio at night, used as the set exactly as shown.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> seated at the wooden table in the foreground of the studio in <Picture 2>, looking into the lens and inviting the viewer to his channel, as the camera holds a locked-off medium shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, hair, beard and clothing are held identical to <Picture 1> in every frame with zero drift.
<Picture 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the room, its furniture, its lighting and the black wall lettering "Cine con IA" are held identical to <Picture 2>; the lettering stays sharp enough to read, letter by letter, in every frame.

detailed_description:
The target video is live-action and cinematic, shot on an ARRI Alexa Mini with a 50mm prime at eye level, locked off, in the low-key night light of <Picture 2>: a cool blue-grey room with lifted shadows, the warm cone of the black floor lamp on the wall, the green glass banker's lamp glowing on the desk, the city lights in the window, and a soft, even frontal fill from behind the camera that lights both sides of his face equally.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> sits behind the wooden table that crosses the foreground, forearms resting on the tabletop, looking straight into the lens. He speaks in Spanish with a natural Chilean accent, calm and unhurried, his lips in sync with every word:
0.3-0.8 s: "Hola." He gives a small nod.
1.0-3.2 s: "Te invito a ver mi canal, Cine con IA." His right hand lifts off the table and opens palm-up toward the camera on "te invito".
3.5-4.6 s: "Suscríbete." He raises his right index finger beside his right shoulder, pointing upward.
From 4.6 s to the end his hand is still coming down to the table and his head is still moving in a slight nod as the shot ends; he never holds a frozen pose.
"IA" is spoken as two separate letters: "i, a".

overall_soundscape:
His voice, close and clear: a medium-pitched male voice, unhurried, with a natural Chilean Spanish accent. Under it, the quiet room tone of a small studio at night and the soft rustle of his shirt sleeve when his hand moves. Nothing but his voice and these on-set sounds.

N/A

camara.instruccion_camara: A single locked-off shot from the camera side of the wooden table, at his seated eye level. <Subject 1> is framed from the waist up, a little right of centre, so that the black "Cine con IA" lettering on the blue-grey wall behind him sits in the upper left of the frame, fully visible and readable. The floor lamp's warm cone and the shelves stay softly out of focus behind him, and the table edge runs along the bottom of the frame. The camera does not move, zoom or cut at any point.
